name: Penanggalan

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

sourceBooks: Monster Vault: Threats to the Nentir Vale
description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

powers.name: Dagger
powers.requirements: The penanggalan must be in maiden form.

powers.name: Soothing Voice
powers.requirements: The penanggalan must be in maiden form.

failedSavingThrows.name: AverageDamage
failedSavingThrows.description: The target is unconscious instead of slowed (save ends).

powers.name: Horrific Transformation
powers.requirements: The penanggalan must be in maiden form.

hit.description: psychic damage, and the target is dazed until the end of its next turn.

effect.description: The penanggalan changes from maiden form to head form. While the creature is in head form, its headless body is considered a corpse. Unless the body is utterly destroyed, the creature can take a standard action to return to maiden form, but only if it is in the same square as at least one part of the body.

powers.name: Bite
powers.requirements: The penanggalan must be in head form.

hit.description: damage, and ongoing 5 poison damage (save ends).

powers.name: Grasping Entrails
powers.requirements: The penanggalan must be in head form.

hit.description: necrotic and poison damage, and the target is grabbed (escape DC 22). Until the grab ends, the target grants combat advantage. At the end of the encounter, the target makes a saving throw. On a failure, the target contracts blistering corruption (stage 1).

powers.name: Malleable Form
powers.requirements: The penanggalan must be in head form.

effect.description: The penanggalan is phasing until the end of its next turn and shifts up to its speed. If it starts its next turn hidden from all enemies, grasping entrails recharges, and on that turn it can use that power and bite with a single standard action.
